environmentalCharacteristics.geology: Limestone and flysch are dominating. Huge layers of tertiary sediments occur in the northern less elevated fringe of the region. The valley bottoms are predominantly covered by quaternary sediments.
environmentalCharacteristics.soils: Rendsina and Ranker are dominating, cover more than 50 % of the area. Brown earth covers almost 25 % of the area. Others: raw soils (6 %), Pseudo-Gley (5.5 %), Podsols, alluvial soils, ...
environmentalCharacteristics.vegetation:
Woodland is dominating - covers more than 60 % of the area; mixed forest (37,26 %), coniferous forest (21,98 %), deciduous forest (4,52 %);
Grassland (Meadows & pastures) covers 15 % of the area
